answer: Reading the documents, repeating the rules, using the vocabulary fluently and declaring understanding measure nothing, and none of them is onboarding (Section 15.8).
ACR cannot always be applied in full, and a participant MUST NOT overstate what was applied.
A setting never waives a requirement and never blocks work by itself.
Role names describe duties and confer no competence, independence or permission.
A counterexample MUST satisfy the original hypotheses and defeat the stated conclusion.
An invalid derivation defeats that support path; it does not by itself prove the conclusion false.
A non-significant result MUST NOT automatically be reported as no effect.
There is no provision numbered 22.7 in acr.core.
Not inspected in this session; no words supplied.
